top_signals.title: OPEC+ Set to Keep Oil Quotas Unchanged
top_signals.summary: The key OPEC+ producers managing their collective oil production are expected to keep quotas unchanged for December when they meet on Sunday, sources familiar with the plans told Reuters on Tuesday. Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria, and Oman have kept their targeted output unchanged after completing in September the phased rollback of 1.65 million barrels per day (bpd) of supply cuts first agreed in 2023. These targets have been only on paper in the past eight months as the Middle East conflict disrupted crude oil supplies…

top_signals.title: Hilton Dips, JetBlue Rallies | Stock Movers
top_signals.summary:
Today's biggest winners and losers in the stock market.

On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Hilton Worldwide (HLT) is falling after the hotel operator gave a forecast for adjusted earnings per share for the fourth quarter that fell short of the average analyst estimate.

- JetBlue (JBLU) shares are rallying after the carrier reiterated its expectation to deliver at least $1 in earnings per share and positive free cash flow in 2028. The shares closed Monday at a record low as the airline grapples with cash burn and elevated oil prices.

- Boeing (BA) shares are on the move after posted a quarterly loss after higher costs affected its commercial-jet business. The company's total revenue grew about 4% to $24.19 billion, driven in part by stronger sales from its defense, space and security business. Boeing generated cash despite the loss, and its 737 program is progressing toward stabilized production at 47 jets a month. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Consumer Confidence Rises for First Time in Four Months
top_signals.summary: US consumer confidence rose in October for the first time in four months due to brighter views about the job market and business conditions. Mike McKee reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)
